cut.title: Cut fragment
cut.mode_fast: Fast - lossless remux (-c copy), no transcoding
cut.mode_exact: Exact - re-encode only the few seconds at the boundary, the rest is copied losslessly
cut.clean_file: Clean file - start at a keyframe (no hidden pre-roll)
cut.snap_forward: nearest keyframe after the mark (will trim lead-in)
cut.snap_backward: nearest one before the mark (will add lead-in)
cut.preview_exact: Frame-exact: only the segment between A and the nearest keyframe is re-encoded, the rest is copied losslessly. The boundary is determined by analysis after confirmation.
cut.preview_exact_detail: Exact cut: re-encode {head} s at the start. Result: {out_a} – {out_b}.
cut.preview_clean_deferred: The start will be snapped to a keyframe (before or after the mark - depending on the choice above) during cutting; the exact range will be reported by the analysis after confirmation.
cut.preview_snap_after: Start shifted to the nearest keyframe: {eff} instead of {req}.
cut.preview_snap_before: Start shifted to the previous keyframe: {eff} (material before the mark will be kept).
cut.preview_clean_no_shift: The start lies exactly on a keyframe - the file will be clean, with no shift.
cut.preview_fast: Lossless remux - playback will start exactly at A.
cut.error_no_tools: ffmpeg/ffprobe not found. Install ffmpeg or set the ffmpeg_path/ffprobe_path settings (mediasort/settings.json).
cut.error_range: End (B) must be later than start (A).
cut.error_start_past_end: Start (A) is beyond the length of the video.
